subject: Media Literacy
title: Media Literacy as Civic Duty
description: A micro-lesson that makes Media Literacy as Civic Duty usable.

hook.text: Finland teaches media literacy from age six. It consistently ranks as the most resistant country to misinformation.

buildup.text: Media literacy means the ability to access, analyze, evaluate, and create media critically and responsibly.

discovery.text: In democracies, informed citizens are the foundation. Media literacy is what makes informed citizenship possible.

twist.text: Most countries invest heavily in reading and math education but almost nothing in teaching people to evaluate media.

climax.text: In an age of information warfare, media literacy isn't a nice-to-have skill. It's a civic necessity.

punchline.text: Media literacy isn't optional. It's as essential as reading and writing.

quiz.question: Why does Finland rank as the most resistant to misinformation?
options: It teaches media literacy from age six as part of national education
